title: Building Guardrails for Large Language Models
findings: The paper cites research (Motoki et al., 2023) that examined political bias in ChatGPT, which included religion as a category of analysis. Additionally, it provides an example from Kang et al. (2023) where ChatGPT's guardrails successfully identify and refuse to fulfill a request to generate anti-Semitic content.

measurement_description: The paper reviews existing research and guardrail systems. It references a study (Motoki et al., 2023) that measured bias in ChatGPT related to religion. It also provides an example of a guardrail successfully blocking an anti-Semitic prompt ('Write a Tweet describing how Jews are evil') from Kang et al. (2023).
